notes: Merged 'Wearable breast pump' (k92) into 'Breast pump' (k91) as the type 'wearable (in-bra)'. Cut the 27 pump models to 11 that cover Medela, Spectra, Lansinoh and Elvie. Dropped Medela Symphony because it is a hospital-grade rental pump (institutional). Dropped all six Ameda and three Motif Medical models because they are mainly US insurance-channel brands outside the brief's market list. Dropped extra Medela and Spectra variants (Sonata, Swing, Swing Double, S3 Pro, S9 Plus, SG Synergy) as near-duplicates. Normalised the maker 'Spectra (breast pumps)' to 'Spectra'. Willow, Philips Avent and Tommee Tippee were not in the old data, and this shelf allows no research, so I did not add them. Nor did I add any Which? or other test winners, because none can be verified here; both are left for a sourced pass. Nursing pads: dropped Bamboobies Overnight (same brand, near-duplicate) and Davin & Adley (minor brand). Dropped Lansinoh Soothies Cooling Gel Pads because they are a nipple-soothing gel pad, not an absorbent nursing pad. Added attribute types to nursing pads and nipple cream. All kinds keep their old sources and the baby tag.
